title: Social Media Addiction
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from social media addiction.
Healing is a journey of reclaiming your time, attention, self-worth, and emotional well-being. These
affirmations encourage mindful technology use, authentic self-acceptance, healthy relationships, and
intentional living. They are intended to complement digital wellness practices, counseling, accountability,
and supportive relationships.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Social media is a valuable tool when used with intention and healthy boundaries. If social media use
is affecting your mental health, sleep, relationships, work, or self-esteem, reaching out to a mental
health professional, trusted friend, or support group can help. Recovery is not about eliminating
technology-it is about using it in ways that support your well-being, values, and goals. Every
intentional choice is a step toward greater freedom and balance.

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I recognize when social media enhances my life and when it distracts me.
I choose intentional use instead of automatic scrolling.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Acceptance
focus: I embrace my authentic self without comparison.
I value real relationships over online approval.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I create healthy boundaries with technology.
I replace screen time with meaningful activities.
I protect my attention because it is one of my greatest strengths.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: I live intentionally and with purpose.
My life is richer when I am fully present.
I choose balance, gratitude, and authentic connection every day.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by my online presence or the opinions of others. I am defined by my character, my
values, and my ability to live with purpose and authenticity. Every day I choose mindful technology
use, I reclaim my time, strengthen my relationships, and deepen my connection with myself and the
world around me. One moment, one choice, and one day at a time, I am creating a life of balance,
confidence, freedom, and genuine fulfillment.
